headline: 318 photos uploaded in 10 minutes by Collector & District Magistrate
reasons: 318 different photos for 162 different works were uploaded by Collector & District Magistrate within 10 minutes, from 2026-05-11 11:16:44 to 2026-05-11 11:26:43.
That is about one work every 4 seconds on average.
The works are in 2 villages: Bamhani, Newari Khurd.
These works are spread over 2 blocks: Balod, Dondi.
